items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: Lester Young was with George Lee at that particular time.

ctx.x: Right, right, right, right, yeah, see, so Piney and -- he was living there, and Jesse Stone was living there, Vic. Dickenson had just come. They had -- when I was there, I was there for about six months, and during this six months was the time when Benny Morton's band and Thamon Hayes -- see, Benny Morton had had a summer job at the Fairlen Park every year. And this year, Thamon Hayes got the job, see, and Thamon Hayes used to be with George Lee. And so he formed a band and he took half of Benny's band. And they…
And then -- what's his name, Benny Morton sent and got Ben Webster. Ben Webster came to Kansas City and he was there playing, Lester Young was with George Lee at that particular time.
